concepts.gloss_en: The thick rain-clouds, glossed as מוחין (the brains/mind) from which drops descend — the entity itself

members.note: representative; the noun phrase itself, equated with mochin

concepts.gloss_en: The action of (thunder) striking the thick rain-clouds — an action about the clouds, not the clouds themselves

members.note: representative; verb+object action phrase, distinct from the entity בעבי מטרא per action-vs-thing rule
same action, only the temporal prefix כש- ('when') added; identical proof context

notes: Split action from entity: בעבי מטרא is the thing (=mochin), while פוגע/כשפוגע בעבי מטרא name the act of striking those clouds (rule 4). The two action forms differ only by the כש- 'when' prefix and share identical context.
